**Back up first.** Before you install this version, make a backup in Settings › Backup & data.

**How much did you eat? A slider now**
- Tap an entry, or review an AI estimate, and move the slider: 1× is in the middle, less to the left (¼, ½, ¾), more to the right (1¼×, 1½×, 2×, 3×). The calories update as you go.
- Tap ¼, 1× or 3× to jump there, or double-tap the slider to go back to 1×. Custom… takes any amount, as a multiplier or in grams.
- Each entry remembers its portion, so the slider opens where you left it.

**Favorites, in one place**
- The Log sheet has two tabs: Recent (your last 15 foods) and Favorites. Under Favorites, pick All, Foods or Meals, and tap one to log it.
- Saved meals are now favorite meals. Yours are all there.
- Long-press an entry on Today and tap the star to make it a favorite with that amount. Select two or more to save them as a favorite meal.
- A favorite keeps the amount you chose, wherever you log it. To change it, tap ⋯ next to it in Favorites and choose Edit. Past days don't change.
- An AI photo or Describe estimate can be a favorite too: it becomes one food, logged as 1 serving.
- Unfavorite is in the same ⋯ menu, with Undo.
